assembled:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create ONE beautifully art-directed, fully assembled hexagonal tabletop game tile for Hanami. This is the actual flat print artwork for a physical game piece, on a genuinely transparent background, viewed absolutely straight down, no perspective, no surrounding scene, no hands, no cast shadow. Flat-top regular hexagon: long horizontal top and bottom edges, points at left and right. Hex width/height = 1.1547. The whole hex fills 94% of a landscape canvas.
Design the COMPLETE assembled tile, not separate icons. A refined Japanese board-game component, coherent graphic design, not a scenic image seen through a hexagonal window. A wide ivory paper rim, fine midnight-indigo outer edge, restrained tiny brass rule. Delicate watercolor illustration composed FOR this hex: one graceful cherry blossom branch with a few large pale-pink blossoms and dark branch sweeping diagonally through the upper two thirds. Generous warm unpainted paper, a clear large identifiable subject, no landscape, no mountains, no buildings, no busy background.
Information belongs to the rim, not pasted over the painting. At bottom center, an integrated indigo inset in the rim carries a large exceptionally legible ivory numeral "3", elegant sturdy book-serif. This inset is part of the tile border design, shaped to the lower hex edge, not a floating plaque or circular sticker. At lower left in the rim, a subtle small indigo wave ownership mark; at lower right, a tiny pale pink five-petal blossom type mark. These accents must be subordinate. No other numbers, labels or iconography.
A real printed game piece with visual hierarchy: blossom illustration first, strength second, ownership quietly in the frame. Crisp graphic printing married to spacious watercolor, tactile ivory stock but smooth clean print. Do not simulate generic app badges, road signs, circular labels, or an ornate fantasy card. All artwork and text is rigidly part of the ONE tile. Transparent outside the crisp hex silhouette.

separation: An imagegen edit removed only the three footer glyphs to make the blank template. An imagegen 4x3 ink sheet supplies strength 1–4, fast/direction/special/victory and the four owner marks. scripts/prepare-printed-tiles.cjs splits the generated glyphs into masks, removes disconnected alpha debris and exports display-size print faces. The renderer places the ink in the reference tile's footer and rotates the whole face together.
